Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added supervised Datacentre bargain trip mode. It travels through every configured world in the selected JP datacentre, forces Bargain mode while active, waits for the Market Board to be opened, runs AutoBuy, then advances to the next world. When storage for the selected buying scope is exhausted or all worlds are complete, it requests Back to Ravana and /logout.
